topic.readerProblem: Site owners are told to block GPTBot and need to know what it actually controls, whether it affects ChatGPT search, and when a block is justified.
topic.connection: Crawler access is the first technical gate for ChatGPT retrieving and naming a brand, which is the visibility AEOeye audits; the page ties it to AEOeye's crawler access study.

assessment: The page argues that blocking GPTBot is usually the wrong default for brands but right for publishers with licensable content, resting on OpenAI's own crawler documentation (GPTBot = training, OAI-SearchBot = ChatGPT search, independent settings) and AEOeye's October 2026 crawler access study (384 sites; GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot and split-setup counts recomputed from the published CSV). It openly says no one can show that allowing GPTBot raises mentions, treats robots.txt as advisory, and does not claim any setting changes whether ChatGPT recommends a site. Older unsourced claims (a Search Engine Journal 70% figure, a GPTBot allow-share reversal, BuzzStream's 49%) were dropped because they could not be verified.

sources.supports: Purposes of GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot and ChatGPT-User; independence of settings; opted-out sites not shown in ChatGPT search answers but may appear as navigational links; ChatGPT-User robots.txt caveat and not used for Search eligibility; ~24 hour adjustment.
July 2025 crawl-to-refer ratios: Anthropic 38,065, OpenAI 1,091.4, Google 5.4.
52% of crawler requests were for AI training as of June 2026, up from 22% in spring 2025; Cloudflare blocks AI training crawlers by default for new domains unless owners choose otherwise.

Managed robots.txt prepends Disallow rules for known AI crawlers (GPTBot among them); compliance is voluntary; content-signal text frames restrictions as reservations of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.
Crawlers obey the group matching their product token; rules are not a form of access authorization.
60.0% of reputable news sites disallow at least one AI crawler versus 9.1% of misinformation sites.
